cost_note: OpenAI Codex OAuth reported zero marginal billing. Nominal token-equivalent cost uses the refreshed live catalog rates and includes harness retries plus zero-cost deterministic verification. No automatic recovery route was exercised; candidates with task failures remain ineligible.
limitations: Eight samples per task class support only a rough p95 (nearest-rank maximum); uncertainty remains high.
The one-shot Hermes host exercises file and terminal tools but is not proof of native per-child receipt wiring.
Provider-internal retry counts and queue delay are not exposed by the Hermes usage receipt.
Synthetic local research evidence tests synthesis and lineage handling without live-web variability.
